items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Lopez, Lopez. You remember that? Yeah, Lopez, yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well that barber shop was right next to... Mr. Lopez.

ctx.x: Oh, and the barber shop, is that building still there, I wonder? The barber shop? Yeah. I might try to take a picture of some of those places like that, Eureka Hall too.

The barber shop was, I don't know, that barber shop was right next to, to, remember that they used to sell pies on the old man? Lopez, Lopez. You remember that? Yeah, Lopez, yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well that barber shop was right next to, I don't know if that place is there yet. Mr. Lopez.

Are there any other old halls over there on that side of the river that are still like down at the Cut-Off or any place that you think might still be there? I could try to take a picture of them sometime, it'd be nice to have a picture of them.
